title: Compare two prices
why: Step 'Look at one other option' is easier when you know how to compare.

steps.text: Read the price of each item
Look at the size too, like ounces (oz) or how many
Find the "unit price" on each tag. It says the price for 1 ounce or 1 item
The smaller unit price costs less for the same amount

tips: You can also just compare the total prices of the two items
